lines.zh: 夜里我才出来，在村里转。
lines.en: I only come out at night, drifting about the village.
I fly low, circling the lamps.
Small wings, quick beats, a thin sound.

lines.zh: 我从屋檐下飞过，没人注意。
lines.en: I pass under the eaves unnoticed.

lines.zh: 菜园里花多，我往那边去。
lines.en: The garden has flowers; I head there.
I settle on the fence for a moment.
Moonlight is enough to find my way.

lines.zh: 我从这扇窗飞到那扇窗。
lines.en: I fly from one window to the next.
I fly close to the wall to avoid the wind.

lines.zh: 我在花丛上慢慢兜圈子。
lines.en: I circle slowly over the flowerbed.

lines.zh: 这村庄的灯，一夜亮到很晚。
lines.en: The village lamps stay lit late.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上落了点灰，不碍事。
lines.en: Ash has settled on my wings. No matter.
I go around the well; it's damp there.

lines.zh: 我飞到草垛后面，那儿暗。
lines.en: I fly behind the haystack where it's dark.

lines.zh: 一只猫抬了头，我飞高了。
lines.en: A cat looks up, so I rise.

lines.zh: 天快亮时，我得找地方躲。
lines.en: Near dawn I must find somewhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我贴在墙上，跟灰一个色。
lines.en: I cling to the wall, the color of dust.

lines.zh: 翅膀合起来，像一小片旧布。
lines.en: Wings folded, I look like a scrap of old cloth.
A village dog barks somewhere off.
I fan slowly to shed the heat.

lines.zh: 灯灭了一盏，光少了一些。
lines.en: One lamp went out; less light now.

lines.zh: 这里挂着旧衣服，我常来。
lines.en: Old clothes hang here. I come often.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等着夜更深。
lines.en: I hold still and wait for deeper night.

lines.zh: 虫子绕着灯转，我不凑近。
lines.en: Bugs spiral around the lamp. I keep my distance.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处更管用。
lines.en: My eyes work better in the dark.

lines.zh: 屋里有说话声，我听不清。
lines.en: Voices inside. I can't make them out.
Heavy dew makes my wings feel weighted.
I wait until everyone's asleep.
I stir my antennae to test the air.

lines.zh: 这村子我熟，每条巷子都走过。
lines.en: I know this village, every lane.
Awake at this hour?
I fly before you, then withdraw.

lines.zh: 灯近了，我往屋檐阴影里退。
lines.en: The lamp comes near; I back into the eaves' shadow.
Don't swat. I'm only a moth.

lines.zh: 你的衣服上，有旧布的味道。
lines.en: Your clothes smell of old fabric.
A clothes moth's case weighs less than cloth.

lines.zh: 你一动不动，我就多待一会儿。
lines.en: Stay still and I'll linger a little.
By day you'd never spot me.
My wings carry a dusting. Don't rub it.

lines.zh: 你手上的灯，离墙太近了。
lines.en: That lamp of yours is too close to the wall.

lines.zh: 翅角皱了，飞起来有点偏。
lines.en: A crumpled wing corner makes me fly off-line.

lines.zh: 我掉到地上，赶紧爬起来。
lines.en: I fall to the ground and scramble up.
A patch of scales is gone and I fly crooked.
I cling to the wall and keep still.

lines.zh: 翅膜破了点，我还挂得住。
lines.en: The membrane's nicked; I still hold on.

lines.zh: 触角断了一截，方向也歪了。
lines.en: Half an antenna gone; my sense of direction tilts.
I crawl toward the dark.
The lamp's too bright; I can't see.
The sound of my wings has changed. Hoarser.

lines.zh: 再碰一下，我就飞不起来。
lines.en: One more touch and I won't fly.
I see that cornflower.
Blue flowers are my favorite.
I circled twice before daring to land.
This bloom is full of nectar.

lines.zh: 我落在花瓣边上，慢慢吸。
lines.en: I land on the petal's edge and feed slowly.
You've raised it too high to reach.
Just a little lower.

lines.zh: 这味道一整天都在勾我。
lines.en: That scent has pulled at me all day.
My wings have gone still.
All right. I'm coming down.

lines.zh: 翅上的粉蹭到你指头了。
lines.en: The dust on my wing brushed your finger.
A half spin, and some scales shake loose.
Some scales came off. It doesn't matter.
I fly to the wall and cling.

lines.zh: 你一动，风就把我吹偏了。
lines.en: One move from you and the wind skews me.

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，撞一下也晕。
lines.en: A body this small gets dizzy from a bump.
I land on the back of your hand to steady myself.

lines.zh: 我只有指甲盖大，也会传粉。
lines.en: No bigger than a nail, and I still pollinate.

lines.zh: 我绕到灯的另一边去了。
lines.en: I've gone round to the other side of the lamp.

lines.zh: 我这么薄，撞了也不碍事。
lines.en: I'm this thin; a bump does no harm.

lines.zh: 灯下绕三圈，我们才碰上。
lines.en: Three turns by the lamp before we meet.
There aren't many moths like us in this village.
There's a white line at your wing's edge.

lines.zh: 绕灯飞三圈，就是我们的话。
lines.en: Three circles round the lamp — that's our language.

lines.zh: 我们落到同一块旧布上。
lines.en: We settle on the same scrap of old cloth.
The night deepens and the people thin out.
My life is long. No hurry.
Under the eaves is safer than out in the open.
Follow the sound of my wings.
Before dawn we must part.
A drop of nectar still on the petal.
I land on a scrap of cloth and sniff.
These fibers would do for a nest.
I can't lift it.
I move it a piece at a time.
Those on the ground are no use to me.
This bit of pollen lasts the night.
I leave it in the corner of the wall.

lines.zh: 掉下来的碎屑，我挑软的。
lines.en: Among the scraps, I pick the soft ones.
This one I can carry.
A shadow moves by the lamp.
I stop on the wall and go still.
That's not a cat. Bigger than a cat.

lines.zh: 我盯着那个方向，翅膀收着。
lines.en: I watch that way, wings folded.

lines.zh: 我听见网兜挥动的声音。
lines.en: I hear a net swing.

lines.zh: 你眼睛在找我，我看得出来。
lines.en: You're looking for me. I can tell.
One move and I'll be seen.
I'm not the only one on this wall.
I'll wait for you to leave.
You're standing under the lamp. Noted.

lines.zh: 我贴在墙上，跟影子重叠。
lines.en: I press to the wall, merging with the shadow.

lines.zh: 你的灯照不到这个角落。
lines.en: Your lamp doesn't reach this corner.
I creep upward.
I know that net-raising stance.
I shift under the eaves.
I fly at night and hide by day.

lines.zh: 这村里能藏的地方很多。
lines.en: Plenty of hiding places in this village.
I hear your breathing. Very steady.
The moment you raise a hand, I'll fly.
A little longer and you'll give up.
I bump the lamp's glass.

lines.zh: 我这力气，连灰都扬不起来。
lines.en: With this little force I can't even stir dust.

lines.zh: 我扑向你的脸，只是虚张声势。
lines.en: I flit at your face. Only a bluff.

lines.zh: 我的粉会弄到你眼睛里。
lines.en: My scales will get in your eyes.
I circle you until your eyes swim.
This little fuss isn't an attack.
One brush and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 我背着一个小壳，在墙根走。
lines.en: I carry a little case along the wall.
I fly higher, out of reach.
Stop chasing. I'm quicker.

lines.zh: 我从茧里钻出来，翅膀湿软。
lines.en: I come out of the cocoon, wings damp and soft.

lines.zh: 这是村子里的一间旧屋。
lines.en: An old house in the village.

lines.zh: 屋檐下风干，我才展开翅。
lines.en: I dry under the eaves, then spread my wings.
Only when it's dark do I move.

lines.zh: 灯一盏盏亮起来，我出来了。
lines.en: The lamps come on one by one, and out I come.
Under the eaves is safe.

lines.zh: 村里有矢车菊，我闻到了。
lines.en: There are cornflowers here. I can smell them.
I settle on a scrap of old cloth.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀比一片指甲还小。
lines.en: My wings are smaller than a fingernail.
The night is right. Time to work.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的翅膀就卷。
lines.en: Fire nears and my wings curl.

lines.zh: 我从墙上掉下来，翻了个身。
lines.en: I drop off the wall and flip over.
Wings soaked, I can't fly.

lines.zh: 冲击把我吹得撞在墙上。
lines.en: The blast blows me into the wall.

lines.zh: 箭头擦过，粉末掉了一地。
lines.en: The arrowhead grazed me and powder fell.
That force stiffens me all over.

lines.zh: 没有花蜜，我撑不了几天。
lines.en: No nectar, and I won't last days.

lines.zh: 一道白光，我什么都看不见了。
lines.en: A white flash and I can see nothing.
No wall to cling to in the void.
